source: historical private local snapshot of the Agent Bridge Qoder runtime (not a public upstream)
removed: in-task input queue, reserved inputs and their exports
manual approval requests, decision events and approval APIs
appServerModel, appServerCollaborationMode and other generic multi-model branches
attachments, image and resource_link prompt blocks
localhost proxy blanking; all explicit proxy environment variables are preserved
tool rawOutput fallback for completion content
agent_thought text forwarding; only one generic progress signal per turn is emitted
changes: qoder-executable.mjs resolves an existing qodercli under PATH, ~/.local/bin and ~/.qoder/bin and spawns it directly without a login shell or installer
qoder-acp-client.mjs sends clientInfo.name codex-squad and keeps a detached process-group lifecycle
qoder-acp-runner.mjs fixes approval to never + danger-full-access; requests bypassPermissions and falls back once to default only for RPC -32603 with exact unknown permission_mode: yolo details
qoder-acp-client.mjs preserves RPC error.data as rpcData; mode failures include stage, code and original/fallback details
qoder-acp-client.mjs records prompt submission only after successful stdin write; runner emits submission metadata without claiming receipt
policy: Derived snapshot for the self-contained plugin. Keep ACP protocol behavior; do not re-add generic Agent Bridge platform branches.
